settings.text: Here you will find answers to the most common questions about your order.

settings.heading: How long does shipping take and what does it cost?
settings.row_content: You will find all information on delivery times, shipping costs and destination countries on our shipping policy page.

settings.heading: Can I return or exchange items?
settings.row_content: Details on withdrawal and returns are in our return policy.

settings.heading: Which payment methods are available?
settings.row_content: Available payment methods are shown at checkout and in the footer of our shop.

settings.heading: How do I find the right size?
settings.row_content: Available sizes and product details are listed on each product page. If you have questions, write to us via the contact form.

settings.heading: How do I care for my products?
settings.row_content: Please follow the care instructions on the product page and on the product label.

settings.heading: How can I check the status of my order?
settings.row_content: If you have a customer account, you can find your orders in your account. We also keep you informed by email.

settings.heading: How can I contact you?
settings.row_content: You can reach us any time via our contact page.

settings.title: Note for shop owner
settings.text: The answers deliberately point to your shop policies. Add concrete details (delivery times, costs, return periods) only once they are final and legally reviewed.
